Passkeys web bridge, pinned upstream release 2.4.0
https://github.com/corbado/flutter-passkeys/releases/download/2.4.0/bundle.js
SHA-256: dd06b08556f161f0518d701fd0a1bf9b3f5144e2e0d6e1f5c3cac81742c0be49

Required by passkeys_web 2.11.0 before Flutter plugin registration.
Served locally; no CDN, remote account or telemetry service.
Unmodified upstream bundle, with Corbado and webauthn-json licenses beside it.
Microsoft TypeScript helper license is embedded in the bundle.

The bridge uses the basic WebAuthn registration and assertion APIs.
Conditional creation and PRF are not used by the Theater-App.
When updating, check the Flutter web plugin and bridge together.
